question: What is in the eighty supplier agreements, and where is Orion exposed?
summary: Sixteen of the eighty agreements cap nothing, eleven let the supplier be acquired without Orion's consent, and three do both at once. Twenty-seven renew themselves unless someone diaries a 90-day notice. Every cell in the grid below carries the sentence it was read from.

blocks.text: Sixteen agreements carry no aggregate cap on direct damages at all: the liability section waives consequential damages and then stops.

cites.anchor: no aggregate cap on direct damages at all
cites.quote: The parties have not agreed any aggregate cap on direct damages under this Agreement.
cites.why: One of the sixteen. The count comes from the grid below, where every cell carries its own quote and can be checked one by one.

blocks.text: Eleven agreements let the supplier assign to a successor in interest without Orion's consent, so a competitor that acquires the supplier inherits the contract and Orion has no say in it.

cites.anchor: assign to a successor in interest without Orion's consent
cites.quote: Either party may assign this Agreement to a successor in interest without the other party's consent, and shall give written notice of the assignment within thirty (30) days.

blocks.text: Three agreements sit in both categories at once — uncapped exposure to a counterparty Orion cannot stop from changing hands. These are the first three to renegotiate.

cites.quote: The parties have not agreed any aggregate cap on direct damages under this Agreement.
Either party may assign this Agreement to a successor in interest without the other party's consent, and shall give written notice of the assignment within thirty (30) days.
cites.why: Both defects in the same agreement.

blocks.text: Eight agreements have no convenience exit whatsoever; absent a material breach Orion is bound for the full initial term of thirty-six (36) months.

cites.quote: This Agreement may be terminated only for cause as set out below.
The initial term is thirty-six (36) months and expires at the end of that term unless the parties sign a written extension.

blocks.text: Twenty-seven agreements renew automatically unless notice of non-renewal lands at least 90 days before the term ends — miss the window and Orion is committed for another twelve (12) month term.

cites.anchor: at least 90 days before the term ends
cites.quote: This Agreement renews automatically for successive twelve (12) month terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least 90 days before the end of the then-current term.

blocks.text: The grid below is the working record: sort it, take the three names from the paragraph above into renegotiation, and put the 90-day dates in a calendar.
